name: Heavy Blows
body:
School transmutation; Level paladin 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target weapon touched
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless, object); Spell Resistance yes (harmless, object)

This spell causes the weapon touched to inflict damage as if it were one size category larger than it actually is.
